---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## App Doctor version

Example: `0.1.0-beta.1`

## Problem

What problem would this feature solve? Describe the workflow or limitation you are running into.

## Target application / framework

If relevant, include the target app type or framework (for example WPF, WinForms, WinUI, Win32, Electron, or custom-rendered UI).

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior you would like to see.

## Why this matters

Explain whether this would improve core QA coverage, compatibility, safety, reporting, source repair, or usability.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches or workarounds have you tried?

## Additional context

Add screenshots, examples, or report excerpts if useful. Remove API keys, credentials, private source code, and sensitive application data before posting.
